raw_sections.Description:
MSI Katana 15 HX B14WGK Laptop is a gaming laptop featuring an Intel® Core™ i7-14650HX, 16Core (8P + 8E) / 24Threads, P-core 2.2 / 5.2GHz, E-core 1.6 / 3.7GHz, 30MB Cache processor, NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Laptop GPU 8GB GDDR7 graphics, 16GB DDR5 5600MHz (Up to 96GB Supported) memory, 1TB NVMe SSD PCIe Gen4 storage, and a 15.6" QHD(2560x1440), 165Hz Refresh Rate, IPS-Level, 100% DCI-P3(Typical) display, making it a gaming laptop with RTX 5070 and QHD 165Hz display available in Egypt through Compumarts.
